lines.trans: Chef flatly refuses to cook this dish.
But why? What happened in the kitchen?
He lost his favorite knife.
Soon you will have a new chef!
He will be fired if he does not make the fricassee.
Guys, let us cook this dish ourselves!
Are you out of your mind? He will kill us!
Yes, you are right, better not risk it.
But if we do not cook, Chef will be fired.
Exactly, you are right, we must cook right away!
Darn, I am confused. This is a dangerous idea.
But we have a duty to save our chef.
All right, turn on the stove and get the meat!
